Hi Pierre,

Thanks for checking in. No, your order Shop···· hasn't shipped yet. The Magic Miner 40T and your Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA are both still waiting to go out together.

I'm sorry, because we told you November 14 and we didn't keep that date. During the first production run, Magic Miner stopped production because of a problem with the control board. That problem is fixed and the final version is approved. All 300 units have been built and will ship together. Magic Miner expects them to ship out from the factory on November 12. We also should have kept you better informed along the way, and that's on us.

As soon as your miner ships to you, the tracking number will be emailed to (email hidden) Some of our emails have been landing in spam, so it's worth checking there.

Best regards,
Sarah
Is the November 12 a typo? As today is November 15.

Hi Pierre,

You're right, and that's my mistake. November 12 wasn't a typo. It was the date Magic Miner gave us for the units to leave the factory. I wrote it as if it were still coming, when that date had already passed before I replied. I'm sorry for the confusion.

I don't have a confirmed date for when your miner ships, and I won't guess one after we've already missed dates on you. I've asked the team to confirm where the units are now and when yours will ship. They're back tomorrow at 10am ET, and their answer will come to you in this email thread.

Your order is still paid and reserved for you. Your Magic Miner 40T and the Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA will ship together. Tracking goes to this address the moment your miner leaves.

Best regards,
Sarah
Thank you for the clarification. I'll await the update from the team.
